description: This file contains implementation code for B53 register access via MII registers, including MDIO operations, switch configuration, and PHY driver registration. It is specific to Broadcom B53 switch chips and includes functions for reading and writing various data sizes over MDIO, as well as probe, remove, and status functions for PHY devices.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_op(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 op)
methods.description: Performs a MDIO operation to access a specific register on a given page, setting the page if necessary, and checking for operation completion.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit (stored in u64) value from a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit (stored in u64) value to a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to a specified MDIO register within a given page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_phy_read16(struct b53_device * dev,int addr,u8 reg,u16 * value)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from a PHY device at a specific address and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_phy_write16(struct b53_device * dev,int addr,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a PHY device at a specific address and register.

methods.name: int b53_phy_probe(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Probes and initializes the PHY device, sets supported link modes, and registers the switch driver.

methods.name: int b53_phy_config_init(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Initial configuration during PHY setup, setting default page and alias.

methods.name: void b53_phy_remove(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the PHY device during disconnect.

methods.name: int b53_phy_config_aneg(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Stub function to configure auto-negotiation, currently does nothing.

methods.name: int b53_phy_read_status(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Reads and sets link status and speed; marks link as up.

methods.name: b53_phy_driver_id1
methods.description: PHY driver for Broadcom B53 (ID 1).

methods.name: b53_phy_driver_id2
methods.description: PHY driver for Broadcom B53 (ID 2).

methods.name: b53_phy_driver_id3
methods.description: PHY driver for Broadcom B53 (ID 3).

methods.name: int __init b53_phy_driver_register(void)
methods.description: Registers B53 PHY drivers with the kernel.

methods.name: void __exit b53_phy_driver_unregister(void)
methods.description: Unregisters B53 PHY drivers from the kernel.
